Twelve genome-level features: genome size, gene number, mean protein length, GC, strict secretome fraction, CAZy, MEROPS and transcription-factor proteins per gene, the nuclear, mitochondrial and extracellular shares of DeepLoc calls, and mean intrinsic-disorder fraction.

A PCA shows how much of the variation lines up with taxonomy; it does not distinguish lineage effects from shared ancestry. Phylogenetically aware comparisons are in the atlas hypothesis pages.
